prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original 3:2 landscape cover for a technical blog about Expo and React Native production release lessons for a real fitness mobile app. Create polished crisp 16-bit pixel art of a futuristic mobile-device inspection bay in the Night City universe, a fresh visual direction with warm ivory enamel, burnt-orange hazard stripes, deep petrol-teal machinery and restrained electric cyan signals. No rainy skyline, no rooftop, no purple desk, no laptop. A single large upright FRONT-FACING smartphone is cradled in a chunky stepped-pixel testing rig, roughly centered just right of center, with a fully visible axis-aligned blank pure off-white #fafafa display about 23 percent of the composition width and 65 percent of its height, portrait display ratio 0.462. The display is completely EMPTY: no UI, no letters, no glare, no reflections, no camera notch. A real app screen will be layered on later. Surrounding machinery has abstract status lamps, a small delivery chute, simplified chip shapes and cable conduits, suggesting native builds, quality checks and release engineering without becoming an exact technical diagram. Bold geometric pixel shadows, amber practical lighting, tightly controlled industrial perspective around a perfectly front-facing phone display. Rich editorial texture, unmistakable stepped pixel hardware, visually distinct from generic cyberpunk desks. No readable text, no logos, no watermark. No people or faces. Landscape 3:2.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original 3:2 landscape supporting illustration for an Expo / React Native production engineering blog. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel-art overhead flat-lay of a futuristic portable field-testing case, open on a dark petrol-teal textured surface under strong warm amber side light. Entire composition uses visible square pixels and stepped edges. Different from a neon desk: no city skyline, no rain, no laptop, no rooftop. Inside the large ivory and orange hard case are TWO FRONT-FACING PHONES placed side by side with perfectly vertical edges, each display a uniform flat EMPTY pure off-white #fafafa rectangle of portrait ratio 0.462. Each blank display is approximately 19 percent of the full image width and 64 percent of the image height. The two phones dominate the composition with comfortable separation and enough screen area to show authentic UI later. Both displays fully visible and unobstructed, no glare, no shading, no notch, no text, no fake interface. Surround the devices with neatly arranged pixel-art diagnostic leads, a small battery module and removable memory cards, teal gasket outlines and orange safety corners. A few abstract cyan check indicators suggest testing but no words or numbers anywhere. High-quality editorial pixel art, warm cream/orange/teal palette with tiny cyan highlights; no magenta skyline. No logos, no watermark, no people. Landscape 3:2.
screenProvenance: Unchanged React Native dashboard and nutrition components imported from private product source and rendered locally through React Native Web, with web adapters for gradients, SVG primitives, icon fonts and a local query fixture. Component compositions, not installed native screenshots. Product source and private repository links are not published.
data: Fictional editorial fixtures visibly labelled DEMO DATA: 2000 kcal consumed, target 2400, protein 130 g, carbs 235 g, fat 60 g; workout 45 minutes, 6 exercises, 7640 steps. No customer records or live API calls.
measurements: No fabricated crash rates, build durations, production user counts or measured speedups. 24 combinations in the article is an explicitly proposed example test matrix.
artDirection: Industrial orange, ivory and petrol-teal release bay and portable field kit, replacing the repeated rooftop/desk composition for this article
